title: Check account setup and verification
scenario: Scenario: account-verification / workflow-map. Open docs/map/workflow.html locally. Python 3.11+ and Git are required for the CLI. Native checks need the selected client; model checks need an offered low-cost model and authorized provider access. Paseo is optional.

steps.title: Check ownership and replacement boundaries
steps.instruction: Find Account setup & runtime in the Anytime band, or search for account-source. Open the account-source node and expand How it works and Sources.
steps.caption: The actual account-source dialog with its source guide link.
steps.expected: Follow account/README.md for install, update, removal and recovery. Preview exact hook commands and execution effects before approving installation and native trust together. Run doctor after setup.

steps.title: Inspect the selected planning runtime
steps.instruction: Close the dialog with Escape. Open planning-hooks in the same Anytime group. Expand How it works and Sources, then follow account/hooks/README.md.
steps.caption: The actual planning-hooks dialog describes the selected source and verification boundary.
steps.expected: Codex and Claude hook registrations have separate native checks. A changed Codex hook is blocked until reviewed through /hooks. The checker never bypasses trust. Native Claude recovery uses a synthetic selected plan.

steps.title: Exercise an actual installed-skill task
steps.instruction: Open Account doctor in the same Anytime group. Expand How it works and Sources. Follow the verification recipe and the account guide for exact commands.
steps.caption: The actual account-doctor dialog separates diagnostics, native readiness and real-model evidence.
steps.expected: Use --native plus --model-smoke with an exact --model and new private --evidence-dir. Add --scenario routing for natural spec-to-plan selection, or --with-paseo for optional spec checks. Inspect identity and per-client recovery results.
